entities.name: Ladislav Štaidl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ladislav Štaidl was a Czech musician, guitarist, pianist, conductor, bandleader, composer, lyricist, music arranger, singer, and businessman. His older, prematurely deceased brother Jiří Štaidl was also a musician and lyricist.
